method: Host tools.view_image, all four PNGs opened
observations: Raw and normalized response plots display all nine fields and four test functions, with derivative panels, units and both table configurations.
Base/hires curves largely overlap at plotted scale; separate difference plot resolves differences and retains LTE zeros.
Arithmetic residuals use a separate plot; number and energy are algebraically dependent checks.
limitations: Response plots use symlog with fixed linear threshold; joining the three alpha samples is visual guidance, not an interpolation claim.
